# AYM Yoga School

> AYM Yoga School is a Yoga Alliance (USA) and Ministry of AYUSH (Govt. of India) certified yoga school in Rishikesh, offering yoga teacher training courses, yoga retreats, and yoga workshops since 2005, with an additional location in Goa.

## Company Information

- **Brand Name:** AYM Yoga School
- **Full Name:** Association for Yoga and Meditation (AYM)
- **Website:** https://aymyogaschool.com
- **Founded:** 2005, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India
- **Tagline:** Yoga school in Rishikesh offering certified yoga teacher training courses
- **Primary Language:** English, Hindi
- **Currency:** USD, INR

## Contact Details

- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91-7500277709
- **Landline:** 0135-2442655
- **Email:** aymyogaschool@gmail.com
- **Address:** Upper Tapovan, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand 249192
- **Google Maps:** https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Upper+Tapovan,+Rishikesh,+Uttarakhand+249192,+India&query_place_id=ChIJhbe6RFwWCTkRDPAGGPqjGUE
- **Second Location:** Goa, India

## Accreditation

- Registered with Yoga Alliance, USA (RYS 200 / RYS 300 / RYS 500)
- Registered with Yoga Certification Board (YCB), Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is AYM Yoga School?**
A: AYM Yoga School (Association for Yoga and Meditation) is a yoga school in Rishikesh, India, founded in 2005, registered with Yoga Alliance (USA) and the Yoga Certification Board under the Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India.

**Q: Where is AYM Yoga School located?**
A: The main campus is in Upper Tapovan, near Laxman Jhulla, Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India. AYM also has a location in Goa.

**Q: What yoga teacher training courses does AYM Yoga School offer?**
A: 100, 200, 300, and 500 hour Yoga Teacher Training Certification (YTTC) courses, along with specialized programs in Hatha, Ashtanga Vinyasa, Kundalini, Prenatal yoga, and Yoga-Ayurveda combined courses.

**Q: Is the certification recognized internationally?**
A: Yes. Courses are registered with Yoga Alliance, USA, which is recognized internationally, and with the Yoga Certification Board (YCB) under India's Ministry of AYUSH.

**Q: Does AYM Yoga School offer online courses?**
A: Yes, an online yoga teacher training course is available for students who cannot attend in person.

**Q: Does AYM Yoga School offer courses outside Rishikesh?**
A: Yes, courses are also offered in Goa and Bali in addition to the main Rishikesh campus.

**Q: How can I register for a course?**
A: Registration can be completed through the Registration page on aymyogaschool.com. Payment options are listed on the Payment Options page.

**Q: How do I contact AYM Yoga School?**
A: Call or WhatsApp +91-7500277709, email aymyogaschool@gmail.com, or use the contact form at https://aymyogaschool.com/contact.

*Note: the answers above reflect information confirmed on aymyogaschool.com's course, about, and contact pages.
